review.duplicates: 164 documents match already reviewed canonical Runtime/TinyRust material after CRLF normalization; runtime-pages.json additionally matches Runtime/data/pages.json byte for byte.
review.uniqueChanges: Later browser, source-options, eval CLI and testing notes were compared with canonical Runtime versions. They describe obsolete SLM1/v0 workflows and scoped historical checks, not current model quality. Useful lessons are transferred to the canonical TinyRust experiment record.
review.metadata: Historical package indexes, route maps and deployment instructions are obsolete snapshots. README/health declare 1.0.6 while version.json declares 1.0.7; their coexistence is not a coherent release proof.
review.evidenceLimit: No old script, model, conversion, training, deployment or claimed historical browser test was executed. The compact record preserves actual file/Git identities, not a new verification of every prose claim.
